paragraphs.en: My name is Eric Morris and I am an avid hunter and outdoorsman.
paragraphs.zh: 我叫埃里克·莫里斯，是一名狂热的猎人兼户外运动爱好者。

paragraphs.en: I like to hunt because it releases a primal urge that I've always had since I was a child to go out and pursue something.
paragraphs.zh: 我喜欢打猎，因为它能释放一种我从小就有的原始冲动，即走出去追逐某些东西。

paragraphs.en: Hunting reconnects you with nature and reconnects you with how life used to be back in the day. A lot of people now have got a little softer.
paragraphs.zh: 狩猎让你与大自然重新建立联系，也让你重新感受过去的生活方式。如今许多人已经变得有些软弱了。

paragraphs.en: They are less independent, less self-sufficient. But hunting allows you to go out and do the things that our ancestors have done for centuries.
paragraphs.zh: 他们不那么独立，更不能自给自足。但狩猎能让你走出家门，去做我们的祖先几个世纪以来一直在做的事情。

paragraphs.en: We just turned off into paradise. There's not many things better than roaming through the woods, looking with something to hunt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们刚刚拐进了一片乐土。没有什么比在树林里漫步、寻觅猎物更美妙的事情了。

paragraphs.en: But here we are. And it's just nice being out there. It's relaxing. A lot of times you can get your thoughts together while you're out there hunting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们到了。在户外感觉真是太好了。它让人放松。很多时候，你可以在外出狩猎时整理思绪。

paragraphs.en: We're gonna park right here. It's already shooting light. We're going to try to see what we can do. There's a process to hunting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们要把车停在这里。天已经开始亮了。我们要看看能做点什么。打猎是有一套流程的。

paragraphs.en: You just don't go out in the woods and find, you know, the animals and shoot them, you know.
paragraphs.zh: 你不会直接就在树林里找到动物，然后射杀它们。

paragraphs.en: You have to get up, make sure your gear's prepared, and with me, I look forward to it.
paragraphs.zh: 你必须站起身来，确保装备准备妥当，我对此充满期待。

paragraphs.en: Hunting does allow you to provide food for yourself, your family, allows you to learn how to survive in the event that you had to.
paragraphs.zh: 狩猎确实能让你为自己和家人提供食物，还能让你学会在必要时如何生存。

paragraphs.en: Who knows what I may have to fall back on one day? I've got some doe pee in here somewhere that I'm going to use. I may have covered it up.
paragraphs.zh: 谁知道有一天我可能要依靠什么呢？我这里有一些雌鹿尿，我要用一下，我可能把它们埋起来了。

paragraphs.en: Here we go. That smells nice and rank. The bucks, they love that. They take this from the doe when the doe is in heat and they bottled it.
paragraphs.zh: 走吧。闻起来又香又臭。雄鹿喜欢这个味道。这是从发情的雌鹿身上提取的，然后被装瓶保存。

paragraphs.en: So, this represents a doe that's ready to breed. We're gonna put this out there to hopefully entice Mr. Big Buck to come in.
paragraphs.zh: 这个气味就代表着一只准备繁殖的雌鹿。我们要把这个放出来，希望能引诱雄鹿上钩。

paragraphs.en: If we don't take Mr. Big Buck, we'll take Mrs. Big Doe. So, we'll see. I forgot my pistol and a spare mag, just in case.
paragraphs.zh: 如果无法引诱雄鹿上钩，我们就设法引诱雌鹿。让我们拭目以待。我忘了带手枪和备用弹夹，这是为了以防万一。

paragraphs.en: Whenever you go into the woods, you got to be prepared. You never know what you might run into.
paragraphs.zh: 无论何时走进树林，你都要做好准备。你永远不会知道你可能会遇到什么状况。

paragraphs.en: Best to have it and not need it than need it and not have it. If one is good, then two is better.
paragraphs.zh: 有备无患总好过临渴掘井。准备一个是好的，准备两个则更佳。
